reviews.review_description: It was one of the few experiences I have had where they did what they said they would do , when they said they would do it. They were quick, pleasant and professional. After installation the sales person rang me to make sure I was satisfied with their service and to assure me they would be available if I had any problems. They also gave me some very good tips on how to save even more money on my electricity bill. The only complaint I have is with my electricity provider who took 3 weeks to change my meter over. I think this is a rather excessive waiting time and I really fail to see why it took so long for them to arrange this.
Our system was only installed this week, so we don't actually know just how good it is yet, but everything else has been excellent.

The rep, Ray, from Solar 2000 was very helpful and answered all our questions and concerns.As the system has only just been installed we are yet to know how much we will save on our electricity.  The installers did a great job and cleaned up after themselves.Thanks for your assistance Finn - all the information you provided was a great help in making the decision on which company to go with.

Quoted 16/2, paperwork signed on 18/2, ETSA approval 20/2, Site inspection 2/3, New ETSA meter 26/3, Installed 12/4.  There was a delay with the arrival of panels from o/s but they kept me informed during this time.  Advanced Solar did the installation and they were very tidy and efficient.  Solar 2000 were easy to deal with and after initially getting confused with the different companies who all have the best panels etc!! I just wanted to get 3 quotes using the Suntech panels and SMA Inverter.  I eventually achieved this and was able to get the best price from Solar 2000!  Thank you.

The first quote Ashley gave me included an inverter which had been discontinued for 12mths. When I said in an email to the salesman I wouldn't accept discontinued stock he said he would offer the inverter I had requested, the UNO 2000. When the installers were installing my system the inverter they had put in was the discontinued one that I had rejected. I was not happy & demanded the UNO2000 which had been on the second quote. Their office rang & apologised, saying the supplier had made the "mistake". Fortunately I had not paid the full balance on the discovery of the wrong inverter being installed so 2 days later the correct inverter was installed & the system paid for. However I cannot reach to read the info panel on the inverter without getting on the 2nd rung of a ladder as it was placed too high, only 37cm from the garage ceiling. I sent an email to the company who emailed back saying they would pass this on to the installers. I have not been contacted by anyone since. I live in a retirement village & would have appreciated some consideration of my height & mobility by the installers, even though I had already  pointed the difficulty out to them.H. Ryan.

The quote was more expensive than the others but I chose the system because I could monitor the output on my computer and see if any panels were weaker than others. The guys who installed it were not sure how to bring the information up on the screen so they organised another person to come out and get it running. He did a really good job. I have since had a power blackout and the information no longer comes up on the screen. I have emailed the company for help but no answer. The input output meter looked like being  a long wait to get it installed but then SA Power had a cancellation and installed mine within a few days and it is working well.

Of the seven companies that we contacted for quotes Solar 2000 seamed to have the best balance of price and knowledge of the system. The installers did a great job and completed the entire installation in less than a day.

After much research we decided to go with Solar 2000 based on the price they gave us for a high spec system, and the many positive reviews we had read. They fit us in on the final working day before the Christmas break with no problems. Now we actually look forward to receiving our electricity bills.

Initially quoted for a micro inverter system but was then told the micro inverters were showing some performance problems. We then had to go with a string inverter system with slightly better performing panels which ended up being the same price.

I would have rated them as fantastic as the sales rep was always accessible, was prompt to get back to me but unfortunately was let down by people in the office who did not process the paperwork that was forwarded to the power supplier.I rang the sales person when I found out from the power supplier that they had no record of an application for our system and he got straight onto the appropriate people and it was sorted that day.Unfortunately though, it may result in our system being commissioned 3-4 weeks latter than it could have.

We are satified that this business was honest and genuine towards our needs with the best offer at the time. The process of installation was effortless and care free as the process can be complex depending of every state. I was quite happy with the outcome as it is a significant investment for middle income earners such as ourselves.. In the end of the day you have to trust someone who knows what they are offering and not just giving you "shop talk" to get hold of your business. Solar 2000 delivered on what they promised - its that simple.

It is early days. I am happy the system has been installed. The proof as to whether we have made the right decision will be determined by if we see a dramatic reduction from our current power costs and if there are no problems with the system itself. If there are problems then how quickly they are resolved. Hopefully, keeping fingers crossed all should be well.
Efficient, helpful and patient sales team and installers.Short lead in time to installation of system and also import/export meter.Good communication and reasonable follow up on queries.

Whole experience from Quote to final installation was refreshingly straight forward.Ashley, gave us an honest quote according to our budget.Solar 2000 took care of all the steps, including meter change over application.Slight delay on installation due to bad weather, but this was out of everyones control.Would definitely recommend Solar 2000 to anyone contemplating installing a Solar system.
Being recently installed in winter, it's too early to say it's fantastic. However, I think it is excellent so far.
very happy with the service.
Great contact, great all over.
Originally we were to get 3 Quotes but only 1 supplier responded.
I found Solar 2000 to be very helpful and I am very happy with the service I received, they were happy to answer all of my questions.
Only that when there was a slight hiccup with the system they were very prompt in coming out to rectify the situation and kept me informed all the time. Very much appreciated.

Solar 2000 were from start to finish professional, friendly, provided great advice and never forceful.Their advice was clear and easy to understand, provided more information than requested and made the decision to use their services easy. Every step once I committed was as explained and the timelines spot on....no surprises!I would use them again and have already recommended their services to others that have asked me about our system and experience. 10/10

I'd looked at a lot of systems prior to making my decision and had heard a lot of contradicting advice from other companies. After signing the contract the installation process was quick and painless. The installers work with you to get the most out of your panels and roof space.
Sales and service was fantastic. All questions were answered and problems solved straight away. Installers were great guys to get  along with.

Throughout the whole process of buying and installing the system the team at Solar2000 were honest and helpful.\r\nThey asked about my needs and explained the best solutions for me. During the install they asked before doing, so that I was happy with where all the extras like to inverter etc was place
Joshs team friendly on time clean tidy professional extreamly knowlegable. Could not fault installation or workmanship.

Experienced sales person offered options we hadn't considered. Quality products. Very clean and tidy installers. Solar 2000 handled EVERYTHING from the word Go, paperwork, ETSA meter, the lot. Pleasure to deal with.

From the initial phone contact with Solar 2000, to the installation, the servcie was friendly but professional. Each team member knew their product and processes and were able help efficiently and quickly

I chose Solar 2000 because of the reviews and also because it  is a local Adelaide company - I did not want to deal with an interstate company.  The consultant who came to give the quote was an older experienced person unlike some young ones sent by other companies, who didn't know their stuff. Other companies I contacted quoted over the phone without even coming to the house! Not dealing with 'remote' installers.Feedback on the progress of the order prior to installation was excellent. The two installers were very efficient and had the system installed and running under 4 hours. I have been monitoring the output and other parameters and can say that the system is performing as expected.I am happy with the system and would recommend Solar 2000 to anyone contemplating going solar.
Been looking around for for a while,solar 2000 had the best answers for what I had been looking for.Good price,good system and good service.
The selling and installation experience were excellent. In between this they seem to have lost their way a bit, but with a bit of pushing from us we got it all done on time and budget.
The sale rep was great, definitely new all about the product he was selling and was able to answer all our questions. Installation time frame was longer than they had originally advised us.

Company was easy to deal with and kept us informed. Sales person was not pushy at all. Left us alone for weeks to just make our own decision in our own time. Small hitch on the day with arrival of installers being delayed but we were kept informed.

Although, the system & warranties was supplied by the company contracted (Solar 2000), the installation was done by another solar company (JSI) who were sub-contracted in.If I had wanted another company to install, I would have gone to them in the first place!!  I had to tell them to move the panels higher up to prevent rain-water cascading over the gutter, which I would not expect from professionals.Overall though, the job was done neatly.

8 weeks to wait for the supplier to install the meter. Not good enough. Not paying money for a system that I can't see operating. Have to wait for installation.Most solar companies want full payment before installation. Not interested, quite liked their systems.

Installed by Josh and his team excellent tidy ,clean  and quick took time tlo explain all workings of system would not hesitate to recomend solar 2000 and install team .Well done solar 2000. Special mention to George sales person knows his businessVery helpful .Thanks Solar 2000
Due to hot weather it took a bit longer than expected.

Sales person friendly and knowledgeable, speed of paperwork and installation was great, however the lack of communication was quite annoying. Had to keep calling/emailing to get an actual installation date. Have since tried to call them in regards to upgrading however again no response to calls or emails.

Solar 2000 was willing to consider the next best roof which faces south since council regulations would delay installation until Feb 2013 if the north-facing roof was chosen.The salesperson was technically competent and was able to confirm that the loss of efficiency could be offset by high-efficiency Canadian Solar 265 W panels on a roof that has a very slight slope.Installation occurred less than 2 weeks after contract signing and the system currently performs better than specifications, generating more than 2.7 kW at midday on warm 35-40Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â°C days with no cloud cover.  I chose a Samil 3.3 kW inverter which is a good match to the system.  SA Power Networks installed a new meter a full month before the promised date and total exported power is more than 3 times imported power.I have recommended Solar 2000 to a friend and they also gave him an excellent deal.

A bit too early to assess the system since it has been in place for only 24 hours. Judging by the installer's attitude, openness and efficiency in installing the system, I have rated everything as "good" above.Hopefully, I will feel the same way after 12 months in service.System is generating a reasonable amount of electricity.

Sales rep said all panels could be installed on north east facing side of house but installer could only do 6 panels on north east side and 6 on east side.Installer did the best they could but incorrect info given by sales rep at point of sale so we won't get the full benefits promised. Also promised installation before Christmas and it was a real struggle to get them to keep this promise after gov announced revoking benefits to those not installed by end of year as company wanted to install new customers not those that had already paid deposit like me but came through in the end after negotiations etc.
Refreshingly good sraight forward team of people. Minimum hype, genuine focus on customer satisfaction and delivering a good service and product. Highly recommended.

Salespeople are not generally technically inclined and will answer questions with quotes from sales brochures. Salespersons are not always familiar with installation practices. Ask lots of questions and tell the salesperson to go and find out.Salespeople will write anything into a contract to win the job, i.e., cabling inside a cavity, without seeing the job. In practice this may not be possible and the installation, whilst of good standard, does not conform to the salesperson's contract.Watch out for advice on inverters and read up on these before committing to a contract. Some contractors may try and sell what they have in stock to clear out surplus units.

All the staff were very helpful and able to answer all of my many questions and the preparation and installation was well planned and completed without any problems.I have no regrets with the company I chose, only praise.
no everything was first rate

Solar 2000 were very helpful, happy to answer all my questions and adjust the quotes to best match our situation.  The order proceeded quickly, with no issues arising and we were well informed throughout.  The installation was performed very well with a professional and friendly crew.  They took less than a day to install 34 panels and left the place all tidy and in full operation.  The system is functioning well and I recommend them.

I have been using the 4KW system installed by Solar 2000 for over 6 months now and am very pleased with it.On the increasingly frequent sunny cloudless days I am generating up to 24.5 KWh per day.This is over 3 times the power I am using from the grid.I calculate that although I'm only getting 26c feed in tariff, and paying up to 34c from the grid, my usageform the grid  plus daily charge at 69c and the majority of water heating at 13c is being paid for by my solar system when the day is sunny and cloudless.I am anticipating many more of these as we move into summer (when I'll need to start using the airconditioner).Overall, I think my decision to go solar with Solar 2000 has been and will continue to be well justified.I calculate my 'pay back time' for the system will be about 4 years.

The service and installation from Solar 2000 was good and well handled.The unit has just been installed and I am still waiting for the meter to be changed to obtain the benefits of solar power.It would be fantastic if the the coordination of the meter replacement happens at the same time as the installation of the solar unit.

I found the whole process from the time of requesting quotes through Solar Quotes easy and simple. The system selected and the supplier were not  the cheapest,  but offered I felt best value for money. Solar 2000 provided good service from the initial contact with the sales consultant George, through to final installation which was done efficiently and without fuss. All staff were friendly and helpful. Just waiting on ETSA do their bit and install the import export meter. The other companies I sought quotes from were also friendly and knowledgeable and I would have been happy to deal with either of them.

Before I found Finn Peacock's Solar Quotes, I did the usual visits and phone around for Solar information. I did not understand a word of what I was being told, anyway I contacted a company that seemed like they knew their business, I am in retail so I know how to treat a customer. The salesman turned up with a single solar tile a compass and a blank note book. I was still trying to get a price on a system 45 minutes into our chat, I was then told the boss would have to be contacted for the final price the boss was phoned and got very annoyed that i would not sign then and there, anyway I bid the salesman good bye and went back online. Hooray! I found Finn's site on solar. I requested three quotes and it was well worth the time to spend an hour or so getting info from Finn's site. So now, I was armed with lots of questions for the sales men and the good thing was I now knew the answers specially the ten questions to ask the nasty sales men. I did some research on the three solar quotes that were recommended and chose Solar 2000. They contacted me within 2 hours of my email and I made the appointment. George the sales man turned up and spent about an hour explaining about solar we went through all the different options and all the prices. Salesman George knew what he was talking about and did not pressure for the sale. I was disappointed I did not get to ask the ten questions to ask the solar salesman as George gave us all the answers before I had a chance to ask the questions. At the end of our talk George the salesman said he would email us the quote on a 7kw system he emailed the quote before leaving our house. We decided to go with the 7kW system and George the salesman came back 2 days later to do the paper work, we then changed our mind and went with an 8kW system George came back (on his day off) to sign the new contract, we asked as we were spending over $16000 what about chucking the blue tooth module in free so we could check our solar information. George decided on the spot that was ok, within a month we were running on solar. We have contacted Solar 2000 a few times for some info and they were great with their  after sales service. I have since recommended Solar 2000 to a relative and they have also signed and got some great service. If it was not for Finn's Solar Quote website I probably would have gave up or signed for something I was told was good.  Thank you Finn Peacock you made it easy.
From the time we received our quote we had the system installed within 4 weeks.  Very good service.

Great service and quote from Solar2000. They have a great range of products for all budgets. Ashley was very quick to respond to our initial query. He came out to our home very promptly, answered all our questions (no matter how stupid they may have been) most importantly there was no hard sell or buy it now price! Emails were responded to very quickly. Ashley even agreed for us to pay a lower deposit (10%) instead of the initial 30% requested. They use accredited installers.The job was all booked with the minimum of fuss (as it should be).However, there was an issue on the day of install  i.e. they (Advanced Solar the actual installer of our system) cancelled 5 mins before they were to arrive. I was initially very annoyed as I'd taken the day off but to their credit they did keep in contact with me and arranged to have my system installed the very next day (Saturday) They arrived promptly, were very polite, installed the system quickly and most importantly correctly using the correct brackets on my tiled rood etc.....very neat install (imho).I would recommend Solar2000 if you're looking for a professional company to install your expensive investment.

The weather delayed installation, no ones fault but the installers kept me waiting for three hours at the weekend 7am to 10 am which was annoying because I didn't need the extra early start.The panels are all up and working but not in the location that the salesman and I agreed, he obviously didn't know as much as he said he did.I am very happy with the system overall and the installers did a good job and tidied up after themselves, this was much appreciated. I would recommend Solar 2000 if asked.
THE INSTALLERS WERE EXCELLENT NO MESS NO FUSS

Solar 2000 provided comprehensive information and responded to each of my (many) queries promptly.  They also appeared to value my custom.  I had confidence in them from the outset because their product knowledge matched the extensive research I had undertaken from manufacturers' websites.Some other suppliers I approached made claims which were not supported by the manufacturers.  I was extremely cautious about the whole process of solar panels as it was foreign territory to me and subsequently I invested a number of weeks to conduct research.  This research also included speaking to people in my suburb, who had installed solar panels, about their experiences, both good and bad.
Very impressed with no nonesense sales approach. Gave me all the facts and figures. System installed only 10 days after go ahead. Efficient, quick tidy installation done within 4 hours.

Have had the unit installed today by very good trades people, They did have a minor accident with one of our ceilings during installation & the follow up was exceptional. A tradie came within the hour after the office was notified & the initial repair was carried professionally. The workers did every thing that was asked of them & Solar  2000 were very easy to communicate with & even provided at no extra cost,  a electricity monitor for inside the home.  I would recommend SOLAR 2000 to others who may be interested in purchasing a solar system.     (It is the first time i have seen my electricity meter going  BACKWARDS !)

Hasn't been installed yet because we haven't resolved how to fit an extra meter into my already large meterbox without paying $3500 to move everything to a new meterbox.None of the companies (salesmen) understood the problem, even when asked directly about it.

Solar 2000 were professional throughout the entire quote and install process.They kept me up to date with the progress and even called when there were going to be anything that I might need to know about the current state of play with solar parts suppliers allowing me to change my order where possible.Their integrity in doing this has been fantastic.

Having already commenced looking at a system and had in fact selected a supplier I wanted to double check the price and the quality of the product and most of all understand why there was such a price variation in different sizes and between like sizes.The information I was able access via the Solar Quotes website enabled me to research further and get a better understanding of what type of system to choose and the more established manufacturers and hence more surity over quality of the product and a warranty that would endure.Of the 3 companies invited to quote only 2 contacted me to provide a quote and both salespeople were very helpful.  The company I chose was the best price for the quality of system we wanted.The only aspect of their service I was not happy with (so far) is that to get a "confirmed" quote/cost required an installer to come on site and if I was then not happy with the quote I would still have to pay a call out fee.  Apart from this - which did not happen - they have been quite good to deal with.We look forward to the system being installed and flicking the switch!My biggest learning has been the organisation which has council support and supposedly better deals and buying power - Zen - was actually the dearest for a comparable system.

From time of contact to installation was only three weeks, with a 20% deposit and everything has been arranged by solar 2000 including input-output meter with etsa. I was really pleased with the installers professionalism and promptness, would be happy to recommend them as I was in a group of three friends who used the same company.

a prob with request to give large deposit upfront, however was reduced to small one on discussing with rep. found request to pay in full prior to installing a concern however only paid after installation done & system seen to be working
the only thing i can say is that money had to be payed in advance evenif you had cash but it caused no problem
reviews.panel_brand: no name on any paper work i have (Other)

reviews.review_description: Salesperson was good and the quality of the inverter and the panels was the reason I chose Solar2000.

We, David and Areeta got Aslhey on site for a free quote and he didn't push me to accept anything!!!!!! All he did was to browse through his documents and left it entirely to me. They have the best products; Suntech panels with a 5.0 kw Aurora inverter, which I purchased. It produce power in very low light condition!!!!! Believe us, we've already recommended him to one of my best friend, who already signed up with another company charging $15000 for a 3.0 kw inverter. We got ours installed within 3-4 weeks and amazingly got our import and export  meter installed by Etsa the following week. No leaking, Please!. Installation guys were polite and respectful. We are happy with the price, it's the best. After all you can still compare if you like, but for us we stick to SOLAR 2000!!!!! Just to say you better make some research before you buy, wise decision. Thank you so much.

Salesman from Solar 2000 were very approachable and answered all questions asked regarding solar, not the cheapest but good quality parts supplied for installation. Installation about 6  weeks as specified as ordered during peak time just after rebates cut. Very happy with performance so far even in theses very overcast condition. Just waiting on ETSA to instal new meter.

The system installed was 2.5kW - 10 x 250w panels with Solivia 2.5 (Delta Energy System - German) inverter. Installation was completed in a couple of hours & workmanship appears to be great. System was up and running straight away but the only delay was the installation of the import/export meter (which took a couple of months) by my supplier.
It took only 2 weeks from quote to installation.

Adam was great. I did get more information from BluSky but unfortunately they were a $1,000 dearer for same components. Solar 2000 supplied a lager inverter at no extra cost to ensure imy system was installed prior to June 30th deadline.System is working well and better than I expected as it's a split East and  West arrays.
The sales person was good, but office was bit vague. Great product and install was second too none. Overall a good expierence.
Electrical contractor/installer was happy to fit in with my working hours for installation.Glad to support a local family owned business.

Installed 30th May, good job done by Advanced Solar, waiting for ETSA to install import/export meter. It's great to watch my old analogue spin meter spinning backwards, on a sunny day about 3, 4x faster than usual forward speed !!! Awesome.

The quote was reasonable compared to the other two quotes. The installation was quick after signing the paperwork. We asked for 10 panels but the installers only arrived with 9 and didn't realise their mistake until it was time to put them on the roof. So I had a good laugh, so they then had to wait around for about an hour for another solar panel to be delivered. Otherwise, everything went well with the installation. For the last 4 weeks the weather has been cold wet and cloudy since our installation at the beginning of June, but the panels seem to be working okay even in this terrible weather. Can't wait for a better weather to see what our solar panels can really produce.
Would also like to say thanks for the 3 quote system. You have it helped me greatly - first up, to decide to get solar put on and secondly, choose a supplier to go with. Cheers!
Everything came together effortlessly once we made up our minds. Can't wait to see the next bill.
Everything went extremely smoothly from the quote to the completion of the insatllation. Great to deal with and very prompt in all aspects. I would highly recommend.
Very happy, thank you for the recommendation.

Solarquotes list of questions to ask suppliers was very helpful - thanks Finn.  The installation was done by Advanced Solar and Electrical who did a great job.  The system manages to produce about 500W even on an overcast winter solstice day. Can't wait to see what it will do in direct summer sun.

The whole Solar experience was a no fuss venture, from start to finish all involved were a pleasure to do business with  and would recommend to any one, from Solar Quotes to Solar 2000 for the system.  A credit to all involved.

Solar 2000 were very prompt in contacting us and quickly followed up on any questions we have. It took a good couple of weeks before the other company contacted us and they just left a message on my phone and did not even followed up.

Hi Finn, yes did get solar 2000 [Salisbury Plains] nearest to Kapunda to install a 5 kw system they ticked all the boxes you high lighted. I have sent you several emails regarding updates. Your advice was the basis for using solar 2000.Thank you.Cheers!Tony Sanderson

Alot of research was done to gain knowledge of a solar system e.g how it works, which quality products, what to stay away from or look out for. We decided on Solar 2000 firstly because the quality products, secondly, the salesman came out to our rural property and was detailed with explainations and my never ending questions! Thirdly we were not charged for extended warranty on inverter, totalling 10yrs. All other companies cost for 10 year warranty with ridiculous compared to Solar 2000. After more research we sent our quote through with a 10% deposit, this was for a 3kw system with12x 250w Suntech panels and an Aurora inverter. I was called a couple of weeks later to say they had run out of Aurora inverters and would I be interested in a Delta 3300 with one more solar panel at no extra cost, as they would not recieve more Aurora inverters until Jully!!! I was a bit annoyed as I thought all my reasearch was over and didn't really know much about Delta inverters and time was running out with June 30th around the corner. So I did a bit  more research and they (Delta inverters) looked like a quality product. So we agreed after more phone conversations with a now, different saleperson he was nice enough but I would like to see the first salesman follow through. Solar system installed by great blokes, however they were surprised when they seen our roof on installation day was a steep pitched roof as they expected a flat roof, even though I had written on the quote that it was a gabled roof at 34 degree pitch. Our import/export metre will not be installed until July 18th. Thanks to Finn Peacock at Solar Quotes, it is a great website and 'bible' for anyone wanting a solar system.

The job was completed in a month from paying the deposit including the meter from ETSA. I was very pleased with the service the best you could expect. Solar 2000 did a great job in organizing everything and Rob the installer was also great with everything done with an obvious knowledge of what he and his team where about. So I was very pleased with the whole show and it works.
Very pleased with the promptness and expertise of the installation cant wait to see the savings

Matt's team did the install of our system today and we are very pleased with the completed job and particularly the attitude of the install team, all of whom were friendly, polite and helpful. They did a very neat job and removed all removed all of the rubbish from the site. We even exported some power back to the grid this afternoon in mid winter, which was a real blast.Thanks for your efficient quoting and organisation of the scheduling for our job. We received our quote the same day requested and the system was installed eleven days later - fantastic service. Our thanks to the entire Solar 2000 team - your business is a credit for South Australia.

From the very beginning everything was fully explained to us by the sales person, ETSA Utilities after installation of our new meter and the guys who finally did the installation.  Altogether a very clean and satisfactory job.

Salesperson and installers all arrived on time and seemed very profesional.  Office personnel answered all inquiries in a timely manner. All installation plus ETSA patch into the grid were completed within 6 weeks of signing our contract and all seems to be working well to the best of our knowledge.

What a pleasure to deal with, from Adam in Sales to Matt & Wade for the Installation.Angelo and the team at Solar 2000 should be very proud. The whole solar experience was no problem from start to finish.Great service all round.

Very smooth transaction. Salesman was knowledgeable & helpful. Installation was on time, profesional, & tidy.I would recommend Solar 2000. I would also like to thank Finn Peacock for all the help that was given & his very informative website.

Although sales person gave me a good deal his advice conflicted with installers. Advised on tree lopping that wasn't needed [got a tree lopped that could have stayed], placement of panels, got installers name slightly incorrect so had trouble checking them out. However, after installers previsit and advise was happy with the outcome although my site wasn't ideal for solar.Finn Peacock's site was fantastic. It gave me the advise to work out what I needed, what to look for in quotes and contracts and what types of panels/inverters to get best value for money.

Overall experience was excellent from the sales team to the installers everything went smoothly and in very prompt time. A special mention to Louis & Travis who installed the system, very professional and polite also providing great advice. Highly reccomend!!
Everything the Salesperson promised was achived. We have recommended Solar 2000 to our extended family.

Would like to thank Finn Peacock for his very informative website & ongoing emails, it made our decision making so much easier.  We decided to go with Solar 2000, one of the quotes arranged by Finn. The system we decided on is the Aurora Inveter & JA panels so hopefully will negate our power bills totally.

So far, everything is good!! Installation quicker than expected!! Installers were good!!I donâ€™t think we will know any more until ETSA, have been and installed new import/meter (5th of July). Although, I was told that the system was up and working anyway regardless as to when ETSA came.

Hi Finn, Thank you for the information you sent us.  Went ahead with one of your submitted suppliers and was very happy with the guys who gave us quotes all helpful. The guys who installed the panels were quick and efficient too. We are now hoping the next electric bill is reduced by as much as we are wishing it to be, won't know until then. The information you gave was very very helpful and appreciated and recommend anyone who is considering solar to read through it.

Very efficient and kept me informed, signed the contract on 15th May 2012, the pre inspection was done on the 18th May and the installation was on the 23rd May.  I got 2.4 system with 12 panels,the company were on time, very neat and professional. Not sure about the savings yet, too soon, but the sky was cloudy and the meter was spinning backwards even though 3 panels were in shade until I get the tree cut down next week. I would recommend Solar 2000.

This was the only company that had a representative call to discuss my needs. He had a sound knowledge of the product and answered all my questions in basic terms. My experience with the administration was not as good as I had to chase them for a couple of weeks to get information for builder - this delayed the start of my build by two to three weeks.
only disapointing thing is that we have to wait so long for our meter which we realise is out of your control so it is fairly hard to answer some of the above questios
Solar 2000's requirement that payment be made by cheque or cash is pretty old hat. Bank transfer is safer and surer for both client and supplier - come into the 21st century.

Every staff member from Solar2000, from sales person to office staff to installer have always kept their word, been punctual and answered all my extensive questions (thanks to Finn).
